title: The Circular Economy

panels.scene: A cavernous investment-bank boardroom, long polished table, city window behind. A term sheet the thickness of a phone book sits mid-table. Three anonymous figures in identical suits occupy the buyer's chair, the lender's chair and the supplier's chair; a single black car is visible idling in the street below.
panels.caption: The supplier, the lender and the customer all arrived in one car.

panels.scene: Same room, later. A whiteboard covered in a financing diagram: boxes for chips, data centres, a compute grant to a lab drawn as an empty rectangle, arrows leaving the largest box and curving all the way back into it. Four hands are pointing, and every one of them points at the same box.

A small beige cubicle, a tired office worker in a cardigan reading a chat window on a monitor. The assistant's answer about a jammed printer ends in one faint grey line of sponsored text, four words long, the only bright pixels in the frame.
panels.caption: Repaid one sponsored suggestion at a time.

altText: Three panels: a boardroom where supplier, lender and customer are the same suited figure; a whiteboard financing diagram whose arrows all loop back to one box while everyone points at it; and finally a lone office worker reading a printer answer that ends in a small sponsored line.
sourceHeadline: Nvidia turns to Wall Street to raise $500 billion for the AI buildout
